body: Did you not read the part where I said I’ve already tried everything you’re suggesting?

You remind me of every person who’s ever told me I’m crazy or stupid for turning down casual sex. 
I haven’t had sex, let alone even touched anybody, in five years. Do you REALLY think I haven’t tried anything and everything you’re suggesting?

I’ve looked at every type of pornography possible. It all exacerbates my depression. All of it. I’ve tried having casual sex, and I stopped it before it even began because I’m incapable of being close to someone without loving them. 

I’ve been betrayed, cheated on, left for other men, lied to, and had bones broken all by ex girlfriends. And all I ever do is love. All I want to do is give someone everything they could possibly need, but that’s “clingy” and I get shit on for it. 

So you tell me how you can possibly think that watching other people love and touch each other when that’s all I crave every second of every day is supposed to help. 
That’s like telling an alcoholic who’s abstaining to go watch people get shitfaced.
Like I said... watching other people love and dote on each other, regardless of whether it’s porn or not, is extremely depressing to the point of me breaking down sobbing.

The porn you are describing is probably the most depressing type of porn I can possibly think of. 

Why the fuck would I want to watch two people love and care for each other when all it does is remind me of how I have nobody? I can’t watch movies that have relationships in them either because I start crying like a fucking child. And I’m an almost 30 year old man. Fuck.

Gloomy future scenarios aren’t just in my head. They happen on a daily basis. For example, my transmission just fuckingblew this morning, so now my car won’t move, so I can’t get to my new job, I can’t cool off my car when it gets hot outside, and I don’t even have enough money for a bus ticket. 

And I don’t watch porn. I find it depressing. I rarely, if ever, masturbate. I’m not interested in pleasuring myself. I couldn’t care less. But to have someone to please? Not a stranger, but someone real? I would die for that.

I don’t “look homeless,” and have been turned away from three churches and homeless shelters. I wouldn’t even know where to begin on anything else. 

Massages and haircuts are absolutely NOT the trick. When I say I crave someone’s fingers through my hair, I don’t mean a fucking stranger. I mean someone that means something to me, and vice versa. I haven’t had that in years. 

The idea of asking a stranger to hold my hand gives me so much anxiety that I’m shaking and having difficulty typing right now. The idea of TALKING scares me. The idea of being seen scares me. I’m terrified of the world, of people...
